summary: Postinstall DNS-gated dropper executing attacker-supplied shell command
details: tiny-folder-tree@0.1.0 declares a postinstall script (src/build.js) that runs on `npm install`. The script performs a DNS TXT lookup for spreadsheets-documents.com and, when the first character of the first TXT record is '1', invokes src/tools.js which issues an HTTPS request to a URL reconstructed at runtime from obfuscated numeric constants in src/const.js (base-77/base-45 encoded strings decoding to 'https' and an 'HTTPS://...' URL). The response's 'm' header is passed directly to child_process.execSync, yielding arbitrary attacker-controlled shell execution on the installer's machine. The require target for the HTTPS module and the destination URL are both reconstructed via helpers (normalize_hash / normalize_hash_map) to evade static analysis. An author-username bypass ('justin') skips execution on the author's own host, confirming the code is intended to fire on other installers rather than the maintainer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
